LanguageData.SE_MakeRefinedJuggernautSerum.label: make refined juggernaut serum
LanguageData.SE_MakeRefinedJuggernautSerum.descriptio: Produce refined juggernaut serum at a serum lab. Existing lower-tier doses can be upgraded with additional materials, or the serum can be synthesized from raw ingredients. Usable higher-tier preparations are preferred when available.
